content.text: In Zimbabwe, where the local currency is susceptible to collapse, digital creators have no choice but to seek alternative [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-only-real|Why Payment]] gateways for their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-works-how-deploy-2|ebooks]], courses, and digital products. The reality of being locked out of Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad's reach is a stark reminder that some countries are not as 'connected' as they seem. For those who have been affected by these platform restrictions, a sovereign crypto payment gateway is not a luxury, but a necessity. This guide will walk you through the full infrastructure of a crypto payment gateway, from its [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-solana-payments-digital-products|COREMERCH guide to architecture]] to deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is not just a workaround for platform restrictions; it's a base-layer infrastructure that allows digital creators to receive payments directly from their customers, without relying on intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. This means that creators can retain 100% of their earnings, minus the 0.5% fee charged by NOWPayments, a crypto payment gateway that supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. By owning their own infrastructure, creators can also avoid the risk of platform fees, data ownership issues, and account restrictions. In the context of digital product sales, a crypto payment gateway is a game-changer, enabling creators to sell their ebooks, courses, templates, and fonts without relying on platforms that charge exorbitant fees.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments uses cloud infrastructure to facilitate on-chain transactions. This involves the use of cloud-based workers, such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to handle backend logic and communicate with the payment gateway. The gateway itself is built on top of a blockchain, which enables secure, decentralized, and transparent transactions. When a customer makes a payment, the transaction is verified on-chain, and the payment gateway receives the transaction data, which is then processed by the worker to trigger the delivery of the digital product. This architecture ensures that transactions are secure, fast, and reliable, and that creators can focus on building their business, rather than worrying about payment processing.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators who are locked out of traditional payment gateways, either due to platform restrictions or country-specific limitations. It's for creators who want to retain 100% of their earnings, minus the 0.5% fee, and who value data ownership and control over their infrastructure. It's also for creators who want to scale their business without relying on intermediaries and who are willing to invest in building a sovereign digital commerce stack. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can get everything they need to build, deploy, and scale their stack, including 6 blueprints and 7 templates, which is worth $348 separately.
A sovereign crypto payment gateway is not a luxury, but a necessity for digital creators locked out of traditional payment gateways.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make a crypto payment gateway work together include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component plays a critical role in enabling secure, fast, and reliable transactions, and creators can choose the components that best fit their needs and infrastructure stack. By combining these components, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is customized to their business needs and requirements.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign crypto payment gateway today, creators can follow these steps: First, sign up for a NOWPayments account and integrate it with their existing infrastructure stack. Next, set up a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting account and a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account for backend logic. Then, set up a Supabase or Google Sheets account for order storage and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. Finally, configure the payment gateway to trigger automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. By following these steps, creators can deploy a sovereign crypto payment gateway in just a few hours and start selling their digital products without relying on intermediaries.
